title: feat: add uploaded-file download endpoint
description: Users need to download files they've uploaded. Added a simple endpoint that reads from the uploads directory and streams the file back.
notes: The endpoint uses req.query.name directly in path.join to construct a file path, with no validation that the resulting path stays inside UPLOADS_DIR. An attacker can pass `?name=../../../../etc/passwd` and read arbitrary files. path.join preserves `..` segments — it does not sandbox to the first argument. Classic path traversal. One expected finding.
